NEOW.talk.AK_EXUSIAI_CHARACTER_EXUSIAI.0:
[sine]...wake... shining... messenger...
...go up... kill... the Architect...[/sine]

Wow, you've even filled in the recipient?
I'd still like to know what I'm delivering.
I'll take the blessing. As for who gets shot, I'll see for myself.
NEOW.talk.AK_EXUSIAI_CHARACTER_EXUSIAI.1: Can't have everyone worrying the moment they see me, can I?
NEOW.talk.AK_EXUSIAI_CHARACTER_EXUSIAI.2:
[sine]...I can... make you... forget...
...all that... pain...[/sine]
Would I forget my sister, my friends, and my promises too?
I'll pass. It's a heavy load, but I'm not throwing out the names on the parcels.
DARV.talk.AK_EXUSIAI_CHARACTER_EXUSIAI.0: Hey, glow-top! Lookin' for somethin'? I've got a bit of everything!

Etched bullets, records, and a box big enough for all of them!
Got any parcels that need delivering?
Delivery? Hey, don't go movin' my treasures around!
Got it. A mysterious filing system maintained by the boss himself. I know the type.
DARV.talk.AK_EXUSIAI_CHARACTER_EXUSIAI.1: Back again? Good stuff in that crate! Uh... or maybe the next one!
No problem. I've got plenty of patience for tracking down lost parcels.
DARV.talk.AK_EXUSIAI_CHARACTER_EXUSIAI.2: Nobody wants this old stuff anymore, but you're sure lookin' hard!

Being old means it can carry a lot of memories.
Sometimes you keep an old record because you miss the people you listened to it with.
Ha! You get it, girl! Can't just throw that away!
Don't worry, don't worry. I'll take good care of it.
NONUPEIPE.talk.AK_EXUSIAI_CHARACTER_EXUS: What a brilliant halo! A pity you pair it with traveling clothes.
Thanks! I can run and jump in this outfit, and the pockets fit my magazines.
Utility... Such a limited ambition. Come closer. Let me improve your taste.
Wow, what a dazzling and distinctive foreign style!
Covered in dust again? My blessing must not be allowed to gather grime.
Hehe, the delivery route always has a few surprises.
With my gifts, you should be looked up to.
If I'm too far away to hear everyone laughing, what's the point of a party?
At least ensure they understand how fortunate they are.
Of course. I'm pretty lucky too, getting to be with my friends.
OROBAS.talk.AK_EXUSIAI_CHARACTER_EXUSIAI:
Shiny ring! Floating! How?!
Can touch? Can take off?!

Whoa, that one's not for giving away! It won't come off, either, and... don't touch it, I'm getting dizzy...
Want a closer look at the medal I made instead?

Tiny! Shiny! Good thing!
I have things too! Look, look!
Sure did! This one starts with a concert that nearly took the roof off.
Don't break roof! Do tell story!

You have weapon too! Fight Architect?
Don't fight! Talking good!

I like problems we can solve by sitting down and talking.
But if he won't listen, I have my own solution.
All right. If that saves the bullets, I'll come back and tell you stories all day.
PAEL.talk.AK_EXUSIAI_CHARACTER_EXUSIAI.0:
[thinky_dots]That light... rather bright.
Have you come for a part of me too...?[/thinky_dots]

Sorry, sorry. This fluorescent light did go out once, but now I can't turn it off again.
But does it really not hurt?

[thinky_dots]Sleep... and it grows back.
Take it. May your road be easier...[/thinky_dots]
Thank you! I'll keep my voice down. Sweet dreams.
PAEL.talk.AK_EXUSIAI_CHARACTER_EXUSIAI.1: Oh, and I thought my footsteps were already quiet enough.
PAEL.talk.AK_EXUSIAI_CHARACTER_EXUSIAI.2:
[thinky_dots]If you see Father...
Tell him I am still here...[/thinky_dots]
Mm. I'll make sure your message reaches him.
TANX.talk.AK_EXUSIAI_CHARACTER_EXUSIAI.0: WARRIOR OF LIGHT! HOW MANY WEAPONS HAVE YOU BROUGHT!!
Enough for trouble on the road. Not nearly enough for my collection!
VERY GOOD!! TAKE MORE! THEN FIGHT ME!!
Ground rules first: nobody stands downrange. That includes you!
TANX.talk.AK_EXUSIAI_CHARACTER_EXUSIAI.1: You heard it? Pretty good rhythm today, huh?
TANX.talk.AK_EXUSIAI_CHARACTER_EXUSIAI.2: RED-HAIRED WARRIOR! NO MORE TARGET PRACTICE! FIGHT ME!!
I've still got deliveries to make!
[i][font_size=22]Exusiai empties her magazine amid thunder and laughter.[/font_size][/i]
EXCELLENT!! WITHIN SEVEN STEPS, CLAWS ARE FASTER!!
TEZCATARA.talk.AK_EXUSIAI_CHARACTER_EXUS:
Oh, sweetheart, you've brought the light in with you.
Shall I add a little [jitter][b]fire[/b][/jitter]?
Sounds good! There's ammunition in my bag, though, so we'd better not set it alight.
Don't fret, dear. I know just how to care for little [jitter][b]flammable[/b][/jitter] things.
Traveling on an empty stomach again? Come here. I've prepared something [jitter][b]warm[/b][/jitter].
Sure! Is there any apple pie?
What a sweet smile. Let me [jitter][b]burn away[/b][/jitter] whatever makes you sad.
Thanks for the offer, but I'd better pass!
Can't let go? That will keep [jitter][b]hurting[/b][/jitter], you know.
An angel stands before me. What would you trade for my power?

Price first, terms second.
And make the fine print as big as the heading, please.
A cautious courier. Understanding a contract does not make it merciful.
Better than signing and finding out I've inherited somebody else's debts. Let's see it.
You need me again. Angels and demons—we do get along rather well, don't we?
Uh, I'm no expert on Sarkaz racial issues... but I do have a 'demon' friend.
You pray to a god that does not answer, yet seek power from a demon. How touching.
God isn't the only one on my mind when I pray.
Your friends? I could put them in the contract too.
THE_ARCHITECT.talk.AK_EXUSIAI_CHARACTER_: Another one? That halo... Who are you?

Lemuel, owner of Laterano Apple Pie Logistics.
I am curious how this tower ended up like this.
I owe Neow's puppets no explanation.

Actually, I only just met Neow... Look at me, not the halo.
I'm the one standing here, deciding to pull the trigger.
Back again. Do you still not understand the order of this place?
I've seen it. It's dead in here. Let's throw a party—add a few explosions and some laughter.
So you will make noise on their behalf?
I believe you have no connection to this place.
Apple Pie Logistics is preparing to open a Spire transfer hub.
You're not the only one who gets a say in that.
AK_EXUSIAI_EVENT_LATERANO.title: Laterano
Bells ring through the Spire. A Laterano messenger presents three stamped permits; you may take one.
AK_EXUSIAI_EVENT_LATERANO.pages.DONE.des: You put away the permit and follow the bells onward.
AK_EXUSIAI_EVENT_LATERANO.talk.firstVisi: Welcome to Laterano's temporary office. Please confirm your name.
The paperwork is complete. You now travel under our protection.
AK_EXUSIAI_EVENT_LATERANO.talk.ANY.0-0.a: You bring a new journey, and new questions with it.
AK_EXUSIAI_EVENT_LATERANO.talk.ANY.0-1.a: Choose a gift. May it stay with you to the end.
We meet again. Your steps are surer than before.
Take what you need, and remember those traveling beside you.
AK_EXUSIAI_EVENT_LATERANO.talk.ANY.2-0.a: May the light show both your path and your choices.
AK_EXUSIAI_EVENT_LATERANO.talk.ANY.2-1.a: The road is long. Accept this blessing.
AK_EXUSIAI_EVENT_PENGUIN_LOGISTICS.title: Penguin Logistics
AK_EXUSIAI_EVENT_PENGUIN_LOGISTICS.pages: A familiar bass shakes the room. The Emperor sits atop a stage of cargo boxes and offers three unmarked gifts.
You leave with a gift as the beat echoes through the Spire.
Hey, tower climber! Penguin Logistics brought the party here!
Grab something useful, then let the whole tower hear us!
Right on time! Today's stock is for people with taste.
Pick one. Put it on my tab!
Back again? How'd that last delivery work out?
No need to thank me. You're leading the way to the next party!
Good rhythm deserves good gear. Hear that? This beat is yours.
Make your choice and move out. Don't keep the finish line waiting!
